scope: Offline source and archived positive-control review; no producer edits, GUI capture, or new compiler run.

archivedPositiveControl.verificationMethod: verify_positive_control.py plus six archived v3 tests; read-only offline checks
archivedPositiveControl.rawStreams: resolver/compiler stdout and stderr paths plus hashes are present; archived bytes match archive-map
archivedPositiveControl.sourceJoin: Witness.swift and CaptureHost.swift pre/post hashes and bytes equal

positiveFindings.evidence: collector/capture_origin.py:202-239; xcrun mode keeps argv ['/usr/bin/xcrun','swiftc'], while logical swiftc path, resolved swift-frontend path, pre/post hashes, and bytes are separately recorded
collector/capture_origin.py:170-193, 211-217, 226-239; start_new_session, TERM then KILL, bounded drains, ProcessLookupError recording, and durable failure receipt are implemented
collector/verify_receipt.py:14-23 and archived verifier; PID/PGID, argv mode, cwd/source paths, raw hashes, tool hashes, source pre/post, exit, timeout, and binary joins pass
test_v3.py; exact five seed rows, byte-exact v2 collector pins, corrected two-file @main fixture, symlink logical path, archive verification, and source/timeout fault rejection

blockers.evidence: collector/capture_origin.py:15-24; nested collector path makes Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] resolve to repository/factory, not repository root
blockers.impact: RECORDER, factory/.venv fallback, canonical case, recipe, and font paths resolve under wrong prefixes; direct seed capture cannot reliably locate required repository inputs
blockers.requiredSourceChange: Derive repository root at parents[5] or via an explicit source-root contract, then repin full collector and stage hashes

blockers.evidence: positive-control/run-control.py:4-9; root is positive-control directory, so root/factory/oracle/mac/seed-origin-v3/capture_origin.py is absent
blockers.impact: Archived runner cannot reproduce recorded control from its staged location; receipt remains valid artifact evidence, but invocation lineage is not replayable
blockers.requiredSourceChange: Stage runnable runner with explicit repository source root or archive exact invoked argv/cwd/source path before seed admission

blockers.evidence: collector/capture_origin.py:170-193, 232; timedOut is assigned only from cleanup.drainTimedOut
blockers.impact: If first communicate deadline expires, SIGTERM succeeds within next drain, and compiler exits 0, receipt can report timedOut false despite deadline breach
blockers.requiredSourceChange: Track first communicate timeout separately; success must require no initial timeout, no TERM/KILL, and complete drain

nextGate: After source fixes are repinned, rerun one bounded internal-cache positive control, then review seed capture admission.
